name: When should I consider upgrading to slip-resistant shower flooring?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider upgrading to slip-resistant shower flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider upgrading to slip-resistant shower flooring if you have elderly family members, young children, or anyone with mobility challenges living in your home. It's also a wise choice during any bathroom remodel to proactively enhance safety. If your current shower floor feels slippery even with a bath mat, or if you've experienced near-slips, an upgrade is highly recommended for immediate safety improvement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrade to slip-resistant shower flooring for enhanced safety if you have young children, elderly family, mobility concerns, or during a remodel.
